name: exploded-aeropress-pareto-26.10-preview-s1-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of an AeroPress coffee maker, as an SVG. Use the original model with a round paper filter rather than the Go or the XL.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 1400" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="plastic" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c3c8cd"/>
      <stop offset="0.18" stop-color="#e8ebec"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#f8f9fa"/>
      <stop offset="0.72" stop-color="#dfe3e6"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b4bac0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dark" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#141417"/>
      <stop offset="0.22" stop-color="#3c3c41"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#5a5a60"/>
      <stop offset="0.78" stop-color="#333338"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0f0f12"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="capTop" cx="0.5" cy="0.42" r="0.75">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#4b4b51"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#202024"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="soft" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/></filter>
    <clipPath id="capFace"><ellipse cx="500" cy="1050" rx="82" ry="18"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <rect width="1000" height="1400" fill="#f8f6f2"/>

  <text x="500" y="58" text-anchor="middle" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#2a2a2e">AeroPress Coffee Maker</text>
  <text x="500" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#8b857c">Exploded assembly view · original model with round paper micro-filter</text>

  <!-- assembly axis -->
  <line x1="500" y1="118" x2="500" y2="1108" stroke="#b9bcc0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 9"/>

  <!-- soft shadows -->
  <g fill="#1a1a1a" opacity="0.05" filter="url(#soft)">
    <ellipse cx="503" cy="252" rx="100" ry="9"/>
    <ellipse cx="505" cy="596" rx="85" ry="9"/>
    <ellipse cx="505" cy="952" rx="95" ry="10"/>
    <ellipse cx="503" cy="1008" rx="58" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="505" cy="1110" rx="90" ry="10"/>
    <ellipse cx="335" cy="1244" rx="150" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="695" cy="1252" rx="120" ry="7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 1 funnel -->
  <path d="M398,150 L434,238 A66,10 0 0 0 566,238 L602,150 A102,15 0 0 1 398,150 Z" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M409,157 L445,234" stroke="#b6babf" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M591,157 L555,234" stroke="#b6babf" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M443,236 A57,8.5 0 0 0 557,236" fill="none" stroke="#b6babf" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="150" rx="102" ry="15" fill="#eef0f2" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="151" rx="93" ry="12.5" fill="#c9cdd2" stroke="#a9aeb3" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- 2 plunger -->
  <path d="M440,326 L440,530 A60,13 0 0 0 560,530 L560,326 Z" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M422,306 L422,326 A78,15 0 0 0 578,326 L578,306 Z" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="306" rx="78" ry="15" fill="#f0f2f4" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="307" rx="56" ry="10" fill="#7d8287" stroke="#85898e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M452,345 L448,524" stroke="#c3c7cb" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.85"/>
  <path d="M548,345 L552,524" stroke="#c3c7cb" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.85"/>
  <path d="M432,530 A68,13 0 0 0 568,530 L568,560 L576,563 L576,575 A76,12 0 0 1 424,575 L424,563 L432,560 Z" fill="url(#dark)" stroke="#131316" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M456,540 L456,566" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.10"/>

  <!-- 3 chamber -->
  <path d="M400,640 Q413,688 424,712 L424,935 A76,13 0 0 0 576,935 L576,712 Q587,688 600,640 A100,17 0 0 1 400,640 Z" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M409,646 L431,716" stroke="#b6babf" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M591,646 L569,716" stroke="#b6babf" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M430,716 L430,930" stroke="#c3c7cb" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M570,716 L570,930" stroke="#c3c7cb" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M430,930 A70,11 0 0 0 570,930" fill="none" stroke="#b6babf" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.9"/>
  <rect x="438" y="672" width="12" height="248" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/>
  <text x="500" y="800" text-anchor="middle" font-size="24" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.5" fill="#9ba0a5">AeroPress</text>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="640" rx="100" ry="17" fill="#eef0f2" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="641" rx="91" ry="14.5" fill="#ccd0d4" stroke="#a9aeb3" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- 4 paper filter -->
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="994" rx="56" ry="12" fill="#dfe2e5" stroke="#c2c6ca" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="988" rx="56" ry="12" fill="#fdfdfd" stroke="#c8ccd0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <g fill="#d3d6da">
    <circle cx="475" cy="985" r="1.1"/><circle cx="492" cy="982" r="1.1"/><circle cx="510" cy="986" r="1.1"/>
    <circle cx="523" cy="991" r="1.1"/><circle cx="480" cy="992" r="1.1"/><circle cx="500" cy="993" r="1.1"/>
    <circle cx="515" cy="982" r="1.1"/><circle cx="468" cy="989" r="1.1"/><circle cx="505" cy="989" r="1.1"/>
    <circle cx="530" cy="986" r="1.1"/><circle cx="487" cy="984" r="1.1"/><circle cx="518" cy="993" r="1.1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 5 filter cap -->
  <path d="M412,1050 L412,1082 A88,20 0 0 0 588,1082 L588,1050 Z" fill="url(#dark)" stroke="#131316" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <g stroke="#4b4c52" stroke-width="1.6" opacity="0.9">
    <path d="M422,1057 L423,1090"/><path d="M441,1063 L443,1096"/><path d="M462,1067 L464,1100"/>
    <path d="M482,1069 L483,1101"/><path d="M500,1070 L500,1101"/><path d="M518,1069 L517,1101"/>
    <path d="M538,1067 L536,1100"/><path d="M559,1063 L557,1096"/><path d="M578,1057 L577,1090"/>
  </g>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="1050" rx="88" ry="20" fill="url(#capTop)" stroke="#131316" stroke-width="2"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#capFace)" stroke="#53545a" stroke-width="2.5">
    <path d="M432,1032 L432,1068"/><path d="M454,1032 L454,1068"/><path d="M476,1032 L476,1068"/>
    <path d="M498,1032 L498,1068"/><path d="M520,1032 L520,1068"/><path d="M542,1032 L542,1068"/>
    <path d="M564,1032 L564,1068"/>
    <path d="M414,1036 L586,1036"/><path d="M414,1043 L586,1043"/><path d="M414,1050 L586,1050"/>
    <path d="M414,1057 L586,1057"/><path d="M414,1064 L586,1064"/>
  </g>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="1050" rx="82" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#5b5c62" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- accessories -->
  <line x1="170" y1="1169" x2="395" y2="1169" stroke="#e2ddd5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="605" y1="1169" x2="830" y2="1169" stroke="#e2ddd5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="500" y="1174" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" letter-spacing="4" fill="#a8a29a">ACCESSORIES</text>

  <!-- 6 stirrer -->
  <rect x="185" y="1210" width="205" height="16" rx="8" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="385" y="1202" width="95" height="32" rx="15" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- 7 scoop -->
  <rect x="600" y="1212" width="92" height="12" rx="6" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M690,1198 L788,1198 L778,1242 Q739,1254 700,1242 Z" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="739" cy="1198" rx="49" ry="10" fill="#b9bec4" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- labels -->
  <g font-size="19" fill="#3a3a3d">
    <line x1="602" y1="150" x2="665" y2="150" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="602" cy="150" r="2.5" fill="#9aa0a6"/>
    <circle cx="681" cy="150" r="13" fill="#2e2e32"/><text x="681" y="155" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#ffffff">1</text>
    <text x="702" y="156">Funnel</text>

    <line x1="440" y1="430" x2="338" y2="430" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="440" cy="430" r="2.5" fill="#9aa0a6"/>
    <circle cx="320" cy="430" r="13" fill="#2e2e32"/><text x="320" y="435" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#ffffff">2</text>
    <text x="302" y="436" text-anchor="end">Plunger</text>

    <line x1="424" y1="780" x2="338" y2="780" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="424" cy="780" r="2.5" fill="#9aa0a6"/>
    <circle cx="320" cy="780" r="13" fill="#2e2e32"/><text x="320" y="785" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#ffffff">3</text>
    <text x="302" y="786" text-anchor="end">Brewing chamber</text>

    <line x1="556" y1="988" x2="665" y2="988" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="556" cy="988" r="2.5" fill="#9aa0a6"/>
    <circle cx="681" cy="988" r="13" fill="#2e2e32"/><text x="681" y="993" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#ffffff">4</text>
    <text x="702" y="994">Round paper filter</text>

    <line x1="588" y1="1062" x2="665" y2="1062" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="588" cy="1062" r="2.5" fill="#9aa0a6"/>
    <circle cx="681" cy="1062" r="13" fill="#2e2e32"/><text x="681" y="1067" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#ffffff">5</text>
    <text x="702" y="1068">Filter cap</text>
  </g>

  <circle cx="305" cy="1272" r="13" fill="#2e2e32"/><text x="305" y="1277" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#ffffff">6</text>
  <text x="323" y="1278" font-size="19" fill="#3a3a3d">Stirrer</text>
  <circle cx="655" cy="1272" r="13" fill="#2e2e32"/><text x="655" y="1277" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#ffffff">7</text>
  <text x="673" y="1278" font-size="19" fill="#3a3a3d">Scoop</text>

  <text x="500" y="1338" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-style="italic" fill="#a09a92">Filter seats inside the cap · cap screws onto the chamber base · plunger seals inside the chamber</text>
</svg>
